meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides open-app prompts, login notices, related threads; blur or hide avatars and media; counts, actions, tags
meta.notes:
**LIVE** (logged out, headless Chrome, iPhone UA 390x844 and a 1440 desktop UA, 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-13). `www.threads.com` serves a mobile-style app (`#barcelona-header`, `#scrollview`, `#barcelona-page-layout`); every fresh load puts a modal sheet over the page.

## Original rules (2026-11-07)

- `open-app-sheet`: `body > div:has(a[download][href*="applink.threads.com"])` matched 1 on `/`, `/@zuck` and a post. It holds the dim backdrop and the card, and nothing scroll-locks behind it.
- `get-app-header`: the header App Store link, 1 match on the same pages.
- `login-wall-notice`: "Log in to see more replies" (post) and "...from user" (profile), 1 each. The header Log in button and the `/login/` nav entry are not matched.
- `related-threads-block`: 1 on a post, 0 on `/` and profiles.
- `login-dialog`: the desktop "Say more with Threads" sheet. The log-in link stays in the header.

## Added 2026-11-13

All counts were taken on `/@zuck` (27 posts, desktop counts in brackets are from `/`).

- `avatars` (choice show/blur/hide): `[data-pressable-container] a > div > img:not([draggable])` matched 28 (the 36 px avatars; media images carry `draggable="false"`). The 64 px header avatar is outside a post and is left alone. The `alt` text is localized and `@` is not allowed in selectors, so neither is used.
- `post-media` (choice): `[data-pressable-container] img[draggable="false"], ... img[aria-hidden="true"], ... video` matched 28 (24 images and 4 videos); with the avatars that is all 52 images in posts. Hiding the `img` leaves the sized box: measured, the post only collapsed when a hashed-class carousel ancestor ten levels up was hidden, which has no stable selector. Hence "Hide leaves an empty box".
- `post-actions-row`: `div:has(> div > div[role="button"] > div > div > svg + span[dir="auto"])` matched exactly one row per post (5 of 5 loaded) and removing it shrank the post from 325 to 289 px.
- `count-numbers`: `... div[role="button"] > div > div > svg + span[dir="auto"]` matched 107 on the profile (four per post), 19 on `/` desktop. "Follow" and "Mention" buttons have no svg+span and are not matched.
- `topic-tag-pill`: `div:has(> div > a[href*="serp_type=tags"])` matched 6 on the profile and 3 on `/` desktop. Inline hashtags in post text have the same href but sit in a different shape and were not seen matched.
- `verified-check`: `svg[aria-label="Verified"]` matched 1 on `/@zuck`. The label is localized, so it only works in English.
- `post-time`: 5 to 28 `time` elements depending on how far the feed had loaded.
- `instagram-link`: 1 on `/@zuck` (the profile header link), 0 on `/`.

## Not verified

- Logged-in pages, WKWebView, the Replies, Reposts and Media tabs, and a reply thread (`threads_post_page_{n}` looked like replies but could not be told apart from the post continuation, so no replies option ships).
- The fixture `post-details.html` is a hand-condensed copy of the observed structure (picture and carousel wrappers reduced), not a raw capture.
